tone.voice: a trusted style editor — direct, tasteful, never pushy

ux_norms: product photography is everything — full bleed images dominate
ultra minimal UI chrome — let the product breathe
wishlist / save to list is a primary action
size selection is a prominent, clear interaction
filter and sort are always accessible
outfit builder or complete the look sections
sticky add to cart on product detail

visual_language.style: editorial, high contrast, clean backgrounds — white or lifestyle
photography_rules: product on white or clean background for listings
lifestyle photography for hero and editorial sections
never use low-res or stock-feeling imagery
visual_language.background_treatment: pure white or off-white — maximum product focus
visual_language.empty_state_style: ultra minimal — thin line icon, single short line of copy
visual_language.onboarding_visual: editorial flat illustration or clean typographic layout
visual_language.illustration_style: when used: geometric minimal — never cute or cartoon

compliance_notes: size and fit claims must be accurate
GDPR compliance for style preference tracking
